question: Which of the following is NOT a physiographic division of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Tibetan Plateau**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The physiographic divisions of India primarily include The Himalayan Mountains, The Peninsular Plateau, The Northern Plains, The Coastal Plains, and The Islands.
 
• The Tibetan Plateau is located to the north of the Himalayan Mountains and is not considered part of India's physiographic divisions.
 
• The Tibetan Plateau, often referred to as "the Roof of the World," is the highest and largest plateau in the world, mainly covering regions in China and parts of India.
 
• India's physiographic divisions are based on distinct geological structures and landscapes, which the Tibetan Plateau does not form part of.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Himalayan Mountains**

 
 
• They are the youngest and highest mountain range in the world, stretching across the northern boundary of India.
 
• They consist of three parallel ranges: the Greater Himalayas, the Lesser Himalayas, and the Outer Himalayas.
 
 
 
• **The Peninsular Plateau**
 
 
• This is a large plateau in southern India, forming the oldest and most stable part of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It is divided into two main parts: the Central Highlands and the Deccan Plateau.
 
 
 
• **The Northern Plains**
 
 
• These plains are formed by the alluvial deposits of the Indus, Ganges, and Brahmaputra rivers.
 
• They extend across the northern part of India and are known for their fertile soil and dense population.
 
 
 
• **The Coastal Plains**
 
 
• They are located along the eastern and western coasts of India, known as the Eastern Coastal Plains and Western Coastal Plains respectively.
 
• These plains are characterized by their rich biodiversity and significant economic activities like agriculture and fishing.
